name: dsh-android-engine
description: npm project whose production install is the DSH-Android engine tree (dsh pinned exactly).
//overrides: dsh pins zod 4.4.3 exactly in ~60 packages; without this npm hoists a newer zod and nests 50 copies of 4.4.3 (~250 MiB). 4.4.3 satisfies every other range in the tree.
//pnpm: pnpm 11 (same major as the dsh desktop carrier) runs dsh's plugin manager on the phone: node_modules/pnpm/bin/pnpm.mjs on the node launcher (libdshnode.so). Pinned exactly; the lockfile carries its sha512. build-engine.sh prunes node-gyp, the reflink binaries and Windows helpers.
